name: PM Cona Industries Limited
industry: Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) & wires manufacturing
description: We manufacture fast-moving electrical goods (FMEG) and wires under the 'PM CONA' brand. Our product portfolio includes modular switches and accessories, non-modular switches and accessories, supported accessories, MCBs / switchgear, lighting and wires, each catering to distinct segments of residential, commercial and industrial electrical infrastructure. We carry out our in-house manufacturing through six manufacturing facilities located across Maharashtra, Uttarakhand, Delhi and Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.
